# Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga Nissaggiya Pācittiya 20 (Bu-Vb Np20)
**ID:** Bu-Vb Np20
**Section:** Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga (bu-vb)

**Title (English, from literature):** Bartering

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)
*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*
The *Kayavikkaya-sikkhāpada* ("Bartering"), designated as Nissaggiya Pācittiya 20 in the *Bhikkhu Vibhaṅga*, sets forth the disciplinary rule prohibiting Buddhist monks from engaging in various forms of bartering or trading [SuttaCentral]. According to the rule, a monk who barters—except when exchanging requisites with fellow monastics—incurs an offense requiring the forfeiture of the obtained item and formal confession (*nissaggiya pācittiya*) [SuttaCentral]. In the origin story (*vorgeschichte*) preserved in the text, the precept is prompted by an incident in which a monk barters his robe with a non-Buddhist wanderer (*paribbājaka*) [Bechert et al. 1997]. Akira Hirakawa notes the rule in his comparative analysis of monastic discipline regarding buying and selling, observing its corresponding place as rule 20 in the *Bhikṣu-vinaya* traditions [Hirakawa 1982].
SuttaCentral records full parallels for this rule across almost all early Buddhist Vinaya lineages, including the Pali *Bhikkhu Pātimokkha* and *Parivāra*, the corresponding *Bhikṣu-prātimokṣa* and *Bhikṣu-vibhaṅga* texts of the Sarvāstivāda, Mūlasarvāstivāda, Mahīśāsaka, Mahāsāṅghika, and Dharmaguptaka traditions, as well as corresponding rules in nuns' Vinaya traditions such as the Pali *Bhikkhunī Vibhaṅga* (Nissaggiya Pācittiya 23) [SuttaCentral]. DharmaNexus detects cross-language alignments with the Sanskrit *Prātimokṣasūtra* and Tibetan Vinaya literature, including the *Pratimokṣasūtraṭīkāvinayasamuccaya* and the Tibetan *Vinayavibhaṅga* [DharmaNexus]. Within the Pali canon, DharmaNexus identifies 519 shared textual segments with 106 other texts, displaying heavy formulaic overlap with other *Nissaggiya Pācittiya* rules (such as Np 10, Np 18, Np 6, Np 4, Np 9, and Np 25) and *Saṅghādisesa* 5 [DharmaNexus]. An English translation has been prepared by Bhikkhu Brahmali [SuttaCentral].
